notes: Genelec 8020D official product page: system response 62 Hz–20 kHz (±2.5 dB); -6 dB cutoffs 56 Hz and 25 kHz; bass amp 50 W + treble amp 50 W Class D (summed to 100 W per the 1031A convention); bass driver diameter 105 mm (=4.13 in, unit conversion only) + 19 mm metal dome; crossover 3000 Hz; reflex enclosure; 3.2 kg; 230 x 148 x 142 mm. No sensitivity or passive impedance published. The page lists a CLF file named genelec_oy-8020.cf2.zip, but its name does not confirm the 8020D revision (sibling EASE files are labelled 8020b), so NO directivity data has been imported; response/directivity remain modeled/unavailable.
